task: Fix high-priority backend scalability findings BSR2-F01 through BSR2-F03

BPF01 / BSR2-F01.change: Partial open-group index; <=100 indexed candidates; independent group claims with SKIP LOCKED; creation-only band guard.
BPF01 / BSR2-F01.preserved: Exact capacity=20, [1,20] fields for 21 concurrent entrants, unique membership/retries, pinned tracks and existing skill behavior.

BPF02 / BSR2-F02.change: Transactional run-keyed pending creator effects for both plays and reach; <=100 effects per partition turn, grouped by creator; skip busy states; atomic projection/deletion.
BPF02 / BSR2-F02.correctness: Permanent CoinReward prevents replay after projection; rollback retains effects; exact threshold timestamps/revisions; new intake checks eligibility; later suspension/test changes preserve accepted effects; deletion cancels pending work in indexed chunks.
BPF02 / BSR2-F02.privacy: No new racer ID column, FK lock or replay document. Pending run IDs can still associate with the retained accepted-run record until projection. Creator erasure excludes intake/reduction through sixteen fixed partition fences.

BPF03 / BSR2-F03.change: Every 16 completed worker jobs reserves privacy, histogram and a rotating achievement/Trackside turn; idle roles and four achievement stages also rotate; reserved failures are isolated and logged.
BPF03 / BSR2-F03.bound: With both presentation roles continuously busy, each gets a reserved attempt within 32 job completions. Under continuously busy achievement classes, each class gets an attempt within four achievement turns (128 job completions). This is per running worker, not a wall-clock SLA.

requirements.R01: Objective implementation review and refinements are recorded below; original capacity assertions retained.
requirements.Q01: Actual command receipts, migration checks, source hashes and applicable task-only patch retained; no deployment/device claim.

objective_review_and_refinements.finding: Initial SKIP LOCKED/create behavior split 21 entrants into [6,15], violating the existing [1,20] test.
objective_review_and_refinements.refinement: Wait on a group when all eligible candidates are busy; guard only creation, then recheck. Original assertion passes without modification.

objective_review_and_refinements.finding: A busy creator or a failed housekeeping role could stall or consume other background turns.
objective_review_and_refinements.refinement: Skip locked creator states, bound rare first-insert waits to 250ms, advance fair cursors before execution, and log/isolate reserved-role failures.

objective_review_and_refinements.finding: Dropping queued effects on later creator suspension would lose already accepted plays.
objective_review_and_refinements.refinement: Intake attests creator eligibility; reducer preserves accepted effects through later restrictions and retains deletion as permanent cancellation.
